title: Trade Analytics Intelligence Workbench
subtitle: Business-to-technology blueprint for trade finance analytics across WCO, TCF and FSDM

stakeholders.interest: LC, guarantee, invoice financing volume, customer profitability, corridor strategy
Trade-related FX exposure, forward hedging, open FX position, nostro/vostro balances
Counterparty risk, country risk, document fraud, ECL on trade exposures
LC processing time, document discrepancy rate, STP ratio, SWIFT repair rate
Trade-based money laundering, sanctions screening, SBP trade returns, export/import reporting
Customer 360° trade view, working-capital solutions, next-best-trade-product

valueChain.name: Trade Origination
valueChain.description: Customer initiates LC, guarantee, collection, invoice finance or FX trade through branches, digital channels or corporate banking.

valueChain.name: Risk Assessment & Pricing
valueChain.description: Evaluate counterparty, country, commodity and transaction risk; price FX, commission, finance spread and capital charge.

valueChain.name: Document Processing & SWIFT
valueChain.description: Issue, advise, amend, negotiate and settle trade documents; transmit SWIFT messages and reconcile with correspondents.

valueChain.name: Transaction Execution & Settlement
valueChain.description: Execute FX, fund trade loans, post charges, book nostro/vostro entries and update balances.

valueChain.name: Monitoring & Reporting
valueChain.description: Track open trade exposures, maturities, AML/sanctions hits, SBP returns and customer profitability.

valueChain.name: Analytics & Optimization
valueChain.description: Corridor analysis, customer segmentation, working-capital optimization, fraud detection and product recommendation.

starSchema.summary: FACT_TRADE_TRANSACTION is the central fact capturing trade finance transactions, amounts, fees, FX and risk measures. It joins to party, product, instrument, geography, currency, correspondent and time dimensions for trade analytics.

facts.name: FACT_TRADE_TRANSACTION
facts.grain: Transaction × Party × Product × Instrument × Currency × Correspondent × Geography × Time

dimensions.name: DIM_PARTY
dimensions.purpose: Importer, exporter, beneficiary, applicant, bank party and correspondent

dimensions.name: DIM_PRODUCT
dimensions.purpose: LC, guarantee, collection, invoice finance, FX trade product hierarchy

dimensions.name: DIM_INSTRUMENT
dimensions.purpose: Individual LC, guarantee, collection or invoice finance instrument record

dimensions.name: DIM_CURRENCY
dimensions.purpose: Transaction currency, settlement currency and local reporting currency

dimensions.name: DIM_GEOGRAPHY
dimensions.purpose: Origin, destination, country risk and Pakistan trade corridor

dimensions.name: DIM_CORRESPONDENT
dimensions.purpose: Advising, confirming, reimbursing and counterparty banks

dimensions.name: DIM_TIME
dimensions.purpose: Issue date, expiry date, maturity date, SBP reporting date and fiscal calendar

lineage.transformation: SUM(FX_SALE, FX_PURCHASE) linked to trade instrument
MAX(counterparty risk grade, country risk grade, commodity risk grade)
EAD × PD × LGD × CCF discounted at EIR
MATCH(Party, Counterparty, Correspondent, Vessel) against sanctions lists
Commission + FX spread + Trade finance interest + Amendment fees

useCases.title: Trade Corridor Profitability
useCases.objective: Analyze revenue, volume and risk by origin-destination corridor to optimize corridor strategy and pricing.
useCases.businessValue: Identifies high-margin corridors and underperforming routes; typical 10-15% revenue uplift on targeted corridors.
useCases.kpiTarget: Cover 90% of trade volume with corridor profitability view by month 6

useCases.title: Customer Trade 360° & Next-Best-Product
useCases.objective: Build a unified view of each corporate customer's trade products, FX, revenue and working-capital gap.
useCases.businessValue: Improves cross-sell and retention; 20-30% higher product penetration in top corporate customers.
useCases.kpiTarget: 360° view available for top 500 corporate customers by month 6

useCases.title: Trade Operations Efficiency & STP
useCases.objective: Reduce LC/guarantee processing time and document discrepancy rate through workflow analytics.
useCases.businessValue: Cuts processing cost by 15-25% and improves customer turnaround time.
useCases.kpiTarget: Reduce average processing time from 3 days to 1.5 days; STP >70%

useCases.title: Trade-Based AML & Sanctions Screening
useCases.objective: Screen parties, correspondents, vessels and goods against sanctions and dual-use lists in real time.
useCases.businessValue: Reduces regulatory fines and reputational risk; improves false-positive rate.
useCases.kpiTarget: Real-time screening for 100% of trade transactions; false-positive <5%

useCases.title: Trade FX Exposure & Nostro Optimization
useCases.objective: Aggregate trade-related FX exposures and optimize nostro/vostro balances across correspondent banks.
useCases.businessValue: Reduces FX settlement risk and improves nostro liquidity utilization.
useCases.kpiTarget: Automated trade FX exposure dashboard by month 12

useCases.title: Risk-Adjusted Trade Pricing
useCases.objective: Price LC, guarantee and invoice finance based on counterparty, country and commodity risk plus capital charge.
useCases.businessValue: Improves risk-adjusted return and prevents underpricing of high-risk trade.
useCases.kpiTarget: Risk-adjusted pricing applied to 80% of new trade by month 18

useCases.title: SBP Trade Returns Automation
useCases.objective: Automate SBP export, import, guarantee and FX position returns from the trade star schema.
useCases.businessValue: Cuts reporting effort, reduces errors and improves timeliness.
useCases.kpiTarget: Automate 5 key SBP trade returns with >95% straight-through accuracy
